276663045.description:
Natural Gem & Mineral Specimen Collection
Quartz Geode, Pyrite Cluster, Clear Quartz Points, and Decorative Beads
Mixed Geological Specimens, 12 Pieces Total
This diverse collection of geological specimens and decorative accents offers a variety of textures and forms, from the crystalline interior of a matched geode pair to the metallic luster of a pyrite cluster. Ideal for collectors or educational displays, this lot combines raw mineral beauty with stylized carved skull beads in turquoise and red tones.
Matched geode pair featuring clear to white quartz crystal druzy interior
Substantial pyrite cluster with characteristic cubic crystal structure and metallic luster
Six individual clear quartz crystal points with naturally formed terminations
Three small carved skull-shaped beads in contrasting red and turquoise tones
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall. The geode halves are a matching set with intact crystal structures. Pyrite specimen is solid with no significant crumbling. Quartz points show varying degrees of clarity and natural terminations. Skull beads are intact. Natural variations and inclusions are present throughout as expected with geological specimens.
